prompt: Break hours of training videos into chapters with titles and a summary of each.
why: Content Understanding segments video and describes each part.
trap: Text summarization needs text first; video has visuals and audio too.

prompt: From recorded meetings, get the speakers, decisions made and action items as structured data.
why: Structured fields from audio are Content Understanding.

prompt: Check thousands of video ads for whether a logo appears and the required disclaimer is spoken.
tells: whether a logo appears and the required disclaimer is spoken
why: Combining what's seen and heard into fields is Content Understanding for video.
trap: Each piece alone covers only sight or only sound.

prompt: Return the guest name, topics and sponsor mentions from each podcast episode as JSON.
tells: sponsor mentions from each podcast episode
why: Field extraction from audio is Content Understanding.
trap: Text tools need a transcript first; this does it end to end.

prompt: Turn a library of recorded lectures into searchable topics with timestamps for each.
why: Content Understanding segments video and returns topics with timestamps.
trap: A transcript alone has no topic structure.

prompt: From each recorded sales call, return the customer's budget, timeline and objections as fields in a CRM.
tells: return the customer's budget, timeline and objections as fields
why: Content Understanding extracts defined fields from audio.
trap: Speech to text gives a transcript, not fields.

prompt: For each safety-training video, produce a list of the hazards shown and when they appear.
why: Content Understanding for video returns timed, structured findings.
trap: Object detection works on single images, not whole videos.

prompt: From each customer voicemail, extract the caller's name, callback number and reason as structured data.
tells: callback number and reason as structured data
why: Structured fields from audio come from Content Understanding.
